login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to continue.
login.wrong: Phone number, email or password is wrong.
login.help: Your clinic registers you and emails you a link to set your password.

invite.expiredBody: Invite links work once and last 7 days. Ask the Aboyun team to send you a new one, or sign in if you have already set your password.
invite.invalid: This link is invalid or has expired. Ask the Aboyun team for a new one.
invite.failed: We could not set your password. Please try again.

Errors.identifierRequired: Enter your phone number or email
Errors.identifierInvalid: Enter a valid Nigerian phone number or email

Email.inviteSubject: You have been invited to Aboyun
Email.inviteIntro: You have been registered on Aboyun. Use the link below to set your password and sign in.
Email.resetIntro: Use the link below to choose a new password.
Email.footer: This link works once and expires in 7 days.

header.waiting: {count, plural, one {# item waiting to send} other {# items waiting to send}}

home.weeks: {weeks, plural, one {# week pregnant} other {# weeks pregnant}}
home.needsConnection: Connect to the internet once so we can load your details. After that the app works without a connection.
home.noVisit: No visit is booked yet. Your clinic will tell you.
home.passed: This visit date has passed. Please go to your clinic.
home.emergencyHint: Press if you or your baby need help now
home.checkHint: Answer a few yes or no questions

LOW.title: You are doing well
LOW.body: Keep going to your visits and taking your tablet.

MEDIUM.title: Your clinic is keeping a close watch
MEDIUM.body: Please do not miss your next visit.

HIGH.title: Your clinic wants to see you soon
HIGH.body: Please call your clinic, or go to your next visit.

tablet.title: Your tablet today
tablet.prompt: Did you take your tablet today?
tablet.done: Well done! You took your tablet today.

check.title: Symptom check
check.intro: Think about how you feel right now. Answer yes or no.

signs.bleeding: Are you bleeding from the vagina?
signs.headache: Do you have a very bad headache?
signs.fits: Have you had fits or shaking that you could not control?
signs.movement: Is your baby moving less than usual?
signs.fever: Do you have a fever or feel very hot?
signs.swelling: Is your face or are your hands swollen?
signs.pain: Do you have very bad pain in your belly?

OK.title: No danger signs
OK.body: You do not have any danger signs now. Keep going to your visits. Check again if you feel different.

CLINIC_SOON.title: Please see your clinic soon
CLINIC_SOON.body: One of your answers needs a nurse to look at it. Please go to your clinic today or tomorrow.

GO_NOW.title: Please go to the clinic now
GO_NOW.body: Go to your clinic or the nearest health centre now. Ask someone to go with you. If you cannot go, press the emergency button.

emergency.title: What is the emergency?
emergency.intro: Choose the one that is closest. Your clinic and your family contacts will be told.
emergency.sentBody: Stay where you are if it is safe. Help is being arranged.
emergency.queuedBody: Saved on this device. It will be sent as soon as you are online. Call or text your clinic now.

install.hint: Put Aboyun on your phone so it opens like any app, even without data.
install.ios: To install: tap the Share button, then “Add to Home Screen”.

session.expiredBody: You have not been online for more than 7 days. Sign in again to keep your records safe.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.body: This page is not saved on your phone yet. Connect to the internet and try again.
